comparison.objective: Quench two aluminium fittings before a deadline while keeping a steel fitting out of water.
comparison.physical_skill: Parallel two-arm sorting and transport under time pressure, not coaxial striking or fracture control.
comparison.success_condition: Both aluminium fittings submerged by 6 seconds and remain there; steel reaches the rack and no hot part touches the bench.
comparison.reason: The task tests classification and concurrent transport, with no sacrificial fracture or retained fastener. No specs or detailed placement/damage tolerances are supplied.
